name: 外部連携の管理ページ内容
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. LH09-0068 full Japanese external-integration content panel, one catalog component; no app sidebar/browser chrome.
ORIGINAL full image1/crop image2 PRIMARY for content/visible states, grouping/proportions, thin arrow/plus/chevron/key anatomy, stroke/optical weights, artwork and fine details. Image3 SECONDARY Japanese copy/layout. Image4 related candidate shows corrected key overlay only, never overrides source.
Portrait logical640x802, PURE WHITE canvas/page, compact natural section spacing, all content visible unclipped. Title「外部連携」Meiryo Bold20/28. Intro Japanese preserves source GraphQL/Slack semantics:「GraphQL APIでデータを扱う公開・非公開アプリやワークフロー、連携を構築できます。」「使い方の資料を確認し、不明な点はSlackで相談してください。」Then inline「資料」with original thin up-right external arrow.
SECTION1 small regular title「認可アプリ」; text「組織の認可アプリを管理します。」inline「資料 ↗」. One WHITE thin-outline rounded empty row: left「認可アプリはありません」; right forest-green gradient primary button thin plus「認可アプリを追加」.
SECTION2「変更通知」; text「項目の作成、更新、削除時にHTTP通知を受け取れます。」Then「資料 ↗」. One matching WHITE empty row:「変更通知はありません」; right matching gradient plus「変更通知を追加」.
SECTION3「メンバーの連携用の鍵」. Two lines「メンバーは本人の権限で操作する鍵を作成できます。」「個人の鍵はセキュリティとアクセスの設定で確認できます。」.
White setting row:「連携用の鍵の作成」secondary「本人の権限で外部連携用の鍵を作成できる人」; right CLOSED white selector「全メンバー」thin down-chevron. This selector is neutral, no gradient.
White list card: header「連携用の鍵 1件」, thin divider, exactly ONE audit row. Original BLACK avatar/white ASMobbin artwork and small white bottom-right overlay with SLATE key (open bow lower-left, shaft/teeth upper-right exactly source); no mint initial. Text「連携用の鍵・読み取り・書き込み・選択したチーム」and subdued「山田 花子が1日前に作成・未使用」. No actual key/token.
Supporting arrows/plus/chevron #526173, white glyphs on primary. Primary gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E, gentle edge/small shadow, no gloss. All body/section labels Meiryo Regular14/24; metadata12/16 tracking0, only main title bold. No new controls/values/extra outer card or nested wrappers. Preserve two empty states, count1, all scopes/time/unused and closed selector.
reviewNotes: Full Japanese panel/GraphQL-Slack-HTTP semantics, docs arrows, both empty states/create actions, closed all-member selector/count1/scopes/audit checked. Section/row labels remain too heavy versus locked Regular; typography correction pending.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
